Or the goal might be simpler: move the black piece to the yellow piece's location, and the game checks the bounding box or center.

<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def black_bbox(frame):
    s=set()
    for i,line in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')):
        if 10<=i<40:
            for j,ch in enumerate(line):
                if ch=='B' and j<50: s.add((i,j))
    rs=[r for r,c in s]; cs=[c for r,c in s]
    return min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),len(s)
print("before", black_bbox(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print("after UP", black_bbox(current_frame))
print("result", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
